display_long_description:
Transform your room into a magical garden — then defend it. Orb Garden is a hand-tracked mixed-reality experience for Meta Quest 3 and 3S, with two ways to play.

SANCTUARY — your cozy garden
Plant glowing orbs that sprout and bloom around your real furniture. Cup them in your hands to nurture their growth. Force Pull a distant orb to your palm like a Jedi. Stretch orbs like elastic between both hands. Draw constellations of light, punch orbs with jelly physics, and clap to harvest them in showers of sparkles. Butterflies drift by, shooting stars streak overhead, and a glowing grass carpet spreads across your floor. No timers, no pressure — just you and your garden.

BLIGHT — defend what you grew
When you're ready for a thrill, enter the Blight: waves of orb-hungry Husks invade your room and you must defend your orbs with your bare hands. Punch them back, charge a one-shot fist, and earn a SMASH to launch them into the walls. Every orb is protected by a hex energy shield. Pick Easy, Normal or Hard, survive escalating levels, and climb the global and friends leaderboards. Watch out for the lava hazards — and the giant boss.

FEATURES
- Two modes: calm Sanctuary gardening + Blight wave-survival
- Full hand tracking — no controllers needed
- Plant, nurture, Force Pull, stretch, connect, harvest
- Bare-hand combat: punch, charged one-shot, and an earned SMASH
- Per-orb hex shields and four Husk types including a boss
- Global & friends leaderboards (Easy / Normal / Hard)
- A hand
